verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents a CLI (`humanlayer automation run`, remote daemon launch tokens) that lets automation environments trigger sessions, giving some programmatic control, but there is no evidence of a documented REST/OpenAPI or SDK-style public API — explicit probes for openapi.json/swagger.json/llms.txt all returned 404. missing for 10: documented REST/OpenAPI or SDK reference, machine-readable API spec, independent confirmation of API usage beyond CLI docs.
